parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Integrate to obtain the form $k(5x-3)^{-1}$ — M1*. OE.
$4(5x-3)^{-1}$ — A1. Or unsimplified equivalent; condone absence of $+c$ so far.
Substitute $x=4/5$, $y=-3$ to attempt $c$ — DM1. DM0 for substituting $(-3,4/5)$.
$y=4(5x-3)^{-1}-7$; allow $f(x)$ or $f=4(5x-3)^{-1}-7$ — A1. OE; condone $c=-7$ as final answer providing $y=$ or $f(x)=4/(5x-3)+c$ OE is seen earlier. Attempts to write equation in $y=mx+c$ form score A0. Do not ISW. Gains max 3/4.
Total: 4.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Carry out stretch by replacing $x$ by $2x$ in their equation — M1. Award if given as the second transformation; do not ignore sign errors.
Carry out translation by replacing $x$ by $x-2$ and $y$ by $y-10$ — M1. OE; award if given as the first transformation; do not ignore sign errors.
$y=4/(10x-23)+3$ — A1. Or similarly simplified equivalent, WWW.
Total: 3.
